education.institution: College of Engineering Pune (COEP Technological University)
education.summary: Four-year undergraduate programme in mechanical engineering with deep involvement in robotics across the Robot Study Circle (RSC), national-level competitions, research, and student leadership.
highlights: Joined the Robot Study Circle (RSC) in December 2021; participated and led across Robocon 2023, Robocon 2024, and Robocon 2025 cycles.
Class Representative from first year — coordinated between faculty and students, managed schedules and processes.
Training & Placement (T&P) Coordinator in third year — organised company interview processes, improved online workflows.
Event head and organiser for Robotex regionals/nationals (Sep 2023) and Mindspark Robotica module (2023, 2024).
